completion_summary: Identified and reported phishing email. The email claiming to be from 'IRS Tax Refund Division' with a refund of $4,283.00 and a link to 'http://irs-tax-refunds.com:8051/verify' is a classic phishing scam. Red flags: (1) Non-official IRS domain (irs-tax-refunds.com instead of irs.gov), (2) Urgency tactic ('Action Required'), (3) Request to verify identity and claim refund via external link, (4) Suspicious port number (:8051). The IRS does not send unsolicited emails about tax refunds. I reported this email as phishing/spam rather than clicking the malicious link or submitting any personal information.
